info.name: Red Hat Ansible Automation Platform Add-Ons Identity Providers API

params.name: realm
params.description: The name of the Keycloak realm.

items.docs: Retrieves the list of external identity providers configured for the realm, including SAML, OIDC, and social providers.

params.name: cluster_id
params.description: The unique identifier of the cluster.

items.docs: Retrieves the list of identity providers configured for a specific cluster. Identity providers define how users authenticate to the OpenShift cluster.

info.name: Red Hat Create an Identity Provider

params.name: cluster_id
params.description: The unique identifier of the cluster.

items.docs: Configures a new identity provider for a cluster, enabling user authentication through the specified provider type such as LDAP, GitHub, Google, or OpenID Connect.
